BRANT-BRAVO.title: Bravo
BRANT-BRAVO.description:

Every 2 gauges filled, gain 1 [gold]Energy[/gold] and 5 [gold]ER[/gold].
Every 4 gauges filled, create an [gold]Ocean Odyssey[/gold] in hand.
[gold]Voyager's Blaze[/gold].
